label: Dropdown Input
title: Dropdown Input
summary: Use a Dropdown Input in a form when people choose one option from a list of four or more.
corePrinciple: Label the question, show the choice, and open the list only when asked.

sources.title: Use the public Dropdown Input contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Declared and installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s Open variant is the field with a Dropdown below it; in code the list opens as a layer over the page when the field is pressed. It works with or without a SafeAreaProvider. On the web the field is a combobox that opens a listbox; arrow keys move through the open list and Enter chooses. The chosen option is announced as selected, invalid, required, and disabled are announced, a disabled field leaves the tab order, and focus shows a ring.
